videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences, and absolutely no English.
Key points from the transcript:
1. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang held an impromptu press conference in Taiwan after GTC Taipei
2. He praised Korean companies' achievements, especially SK Hynix's HBM (High Bandwidth Memory), emphasizing close relationship with NVIDIA
3. He mentioned Korean companies are smart and technologically advanced, specifically mentioning robotics as next-gen tech where NVIDIA wants to contribute
4. He said he'd hold GTC in Seoul if Korea wants it, mentioning Korea has been special to him since GeForce early days
5. He praised Korean imagination, creativity, and ambition
6. He distributed chicken to reporters and citizens, saying Korean chicken is the best
7. Attendees at the dinner included executives from SK Hynix, Naver Cloud, Samsung Electronics, LG Science Park
8. He will meet with Korean conglomerate heads from May 5th: SK Group Chairman Chey Tae-won, LG Group Chairman Koo Kwang-mo, Naver Chairman Lee Hae-jin
9. Hyundai Motor Group Chairman Chung Eui-sun is coordinating schedule, Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-yong will be absent due to overseas schedule
10. Likely dinner location is a pork belly restaurant in Seongsu-dong, Seoul
